Ava: pushed changes addressing the comments on PR #4123 (split tests, null-case guard, updated smoke script). PTAL when you have a sec — trying to catch the next canary slot. diff: https://git.redwood/PR/4123
Ben: taking a quick look now. One heads-up — there was a rename in the KV allocator tests on main, might need a rebase.
Ava: thanks, rebased and force-pushed. fixed the import paths and a flaky assertion. CI triggered: https://ci.redwood/builds/5678
Clara: PTAL — left one optional nit about a comment but not blocking. overall looks much cleaner.
Ava: addressed the comment Clara mentioned and updated the README snippet about the config toggle.
Dan (release-bot): Canary slot requested for PR #4123 at 2025-03-18T15:00Z — awaiting approvals (need 2 approvers).
Erin: I can give one approval after CI is green. Ben, can you run a quick smoke locally for the test shuffle?
Ben: running smoke now, will report back in ~15m.
Ava: added a tiny fix for the flaky assert, snippet below:
```
- assert(len(queue) > 0)
+ assert(queue), "expected non-empty queue for rotate path"
```
Ben: smoke passed locally, CI just turned green (build 5678). approving now :thumbsup:
Clara: approved ✅
Dan (release-bot): Approval threshold met. Scheduling canary for PR #4123.
Ava: thanks everyone. merging into main at canary window start and will monitor logs for 30m. I’ll post results here and revert if we see regressions.
